recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core Encounter follow-up is needed for FHIR-32130; any future changes to parallel reason elements in EpisodeOfCare or Appointment should remain tied to their own Jira decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-32130 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Administration change request raised in R4 and applied for R5. It asked to support DiagnosticReport in Encounter.reasonReference because a DiagnosticReport may group and interpret observations that explain why an Encounter takes place. The resolution accepted the request with modification due to the FHIR-16148 Encounter.reason redesign.
initial_application: Commit 4750ea8dbfa2199dcc06bd87ddef799ad59fe832, titled 'FHIR-32130 Encounter.reason references DiagnosticReport', added DiagnosticReport to the Encounter reason target profiles in source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml. Later Encounter.reason restructuring moved the check to Encounter.reason.value, and the DiagnosticReport target remains present there.
additional_context: FHIR-16148 reworked Encounter.reason/diagnosis for R5, explaining why the original R4 Encounter.reasonReference name no longer appears as the current source element. Later Encounter reconciliation work corrected reason prose and changed other targets without removing DiagnosticReport. FHIR-48869 later synchronized EpisodeOfCare and Appointment reason references while explicitly leaving Encounter.reason.value references unchanged; it is already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini lists Encounter as an active build resource, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml lists http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/DiagnosticReport as a targetProfile for Encounter.reason.value.

related_jiras.note: Redesigned Encounter.reason/diagnosis for R5 and explains why FHIR-32130 is checked at Encounter.reason.value rather than R4 Encounter.reasonReference.
Later reconciliation corrected Encounter.reason prose while preserving the current reason target profiles, including DiagnosticReport.
Synchronized EpisodeOfCare and Appointment reason targets and explicitly left Encounter.reason.value references unchanged; already represented on the combined branch.
